_doc: Single source of truth for the Athlete Intelligence engine (scripts/build-athlete-intel-2026.mjs) AND the client-side what-if simulator. Imported by both (Node readFileSync + TS resolveJsonModule) so the two CANNOT drift. Every weight is a designed constant grounded in the CrossFit L1 framework and the NSCA-researched ARCHETYPES/ENERGY_CROSSOVER in src/fitness/fitnessData.ts. An event's 10-skill demand vector = modality + load + timeDomain component weights, summed then normalized. No fabricated athlete data lives here; these are taxonomy weights only.
_unmeasuredNote: Flexibility has no signal in competition results (no ROM data exists for the field). It is shown as 'not measured from competition data', never fabricated.

modalityDemand._doc: Per-modality skill emphasis (0..1), one row per CrossFit modal domain. Grounded in the ARCHETYPES: Olympic Weightlifter [Str9,Pow10,Coord8], Marathoner [End10,Sta9], Artistic Gymnast [Coord10,Bal10,Acc9,Agi9].

loadDemand._doc: Additive emphasis by load level. Heavy/max amplify Strength+Power; bodyweight shifts toward relative strength + body control.

timeDomainDemand._doc: Additive emphasis by time domain. Sprint favors Power+Speed (phosphagen/glycolytic); endurance favors Endurance+Stamina (oxidative).

timeDomainSeconds._doc: Representative effort duration (s) per time domain, used to look up the Gastin energy-system split for events without a measured winner time. Strength/max events map to the phosphagen end.

energyCrossover._doc: Gastin 2001 % energy-system contribution by effort duration (s), copied verbatim from ENERGY_CROSSOVER in src/fitness/fitnessData.ts. Linearly interpolated by the engine. Each row sums to 100.

modalBuckets._doc: Hopper-readiness axes (extends CapacityView MODAL_BUCKETS with a 'sprint' time axis). An event belongs to a bucket per the test described; an event can be in several. perf per bucket = mean placement-percentile across the athlete's events in that bucket.

skillFromAxes._doc: The 10 general physical skills derived from the differentiated competition AXES (modal-domain + load + time perf). Each skill = weighted mean of the athlete's perf on the named axes. Weights grounded in the L1 skill definitions: Strength<-heavy/weightlifting load, Endurance/Stamina<-long engine + metabolic, Power<-weightlifting+sprint, Speed<-sprint+metabolic, the practiced skills (Coordination/Agility/Balance/Accuracy)<-gymnastics(+weightlifting technique). Flexibility has no axis (unmeasured).

projectionBlend._doc: Projected expected-output for an athlete on an event = measuredWeight * the athlete's measured modal-bucket rel for the event's dominant modality + similarityWeight * 100 * cosine(athlete skill vector, event demand vector). Measured results are stronger evidence than skill-vector similarity, hence 0.6/0.4. Displayed in the UI.

seasonRankWeights._doc: SeasonRank blend. season = 2026 Open+QF capacity z-score; priorForm = decayed capacity of last 1-2 Games (0 for rookies, with widened confidence band, never imputed); age = gentle multiplier from the aging curve peaking ~24-30. Every weight shown in the UI methodology.

confidenceThresholds._doc: high = strong season data AND prior-Games depth; low = thin/rookie or mostly placement-fallback.
